purpose_KO: 배포에서 알려진 대상 종류를 grounding 요청에 명시했을 때 대상 소유권 판별이 개선되는지 공개·합성 source만으로 확인합니다. V81의 모든 종류 동시 요청 결과와 구분되는 추가 입력 조건입니다.
motivation: V81 saved diagnosis: all56 strict C-to-V points have predictedmask IoU higher with another annotated instance than with intended target. This supports an ownership ambiguity diagnosis; it does not certify detector causality for all56.

changed_information_contract.deployment_availability: The requested target category is the task's known constant pallet. No current223 annotation/score/type-dependent decision is needed to provide this string.
changed_information_contract.SYNTHETIC: Every target receives the same fixed category pallet.
changed_information_contract.YCB_PUBLIC_REAL: Requested category is provided using the source annotation object's published canonical category. This is GT-metadata-provided class side information, not a model-predicted class and not class-free zero-shot identification. It is an explicit source emulation of an externally specified category request.
changed_information_contract.unknown_category_or_wrong_provided_categ: Not tested; no claim of robustness to a missing or incorrect category request.
changed_information_contract.same_class_instances: Category is not instance identity. Multiple same-category instances can still be ambiguous; retain them and report counts rather than use GT instance selection.

caption_rule: Exactly requested_category + a single period. No alternatives, synonyms, class-index tokens or per-row text choices.

cohort.query_geometry: Copy all original q8/L/querybox/native order bit-for-bit; no recentering, resizing choice, coordinate optimization or missing-point generation.
cohort.retained: All original rows including invalid/outside q and future association failures. No result-based subset or visibility admission.
cohort.source_initializer_limit: Public YCB q is source GT-derived geometry plus source-only synthetic error emulation. It is not an independently run pallet initializer. Repeated source VAL is development evidence, not a fresh final test.

detector.asset_reuse: Use sealed V81 local weights/config/tokenizer and isolated hub0.36.0 overlay; no new asset/model or installation.
detector.runtime: Same official transformers4.57.6 explicit slow GroundingDinoImageProcessor+BertTokenizer, eval FP32/no autocast, TF32 false, threads1, batch1, custom kernels disabled, all weights frozen.
detector.unique_forward_key: decoded input RGB file SHA plus exact caption; multiple q-box targets of the same image/category reuse the same raw detector result.
detector.determinism: Repeat the first unique image/category forward once. Require identical boxes, FP32 active logits, maxscores, order and labels. Loading-info lists empty and full state digest unchanged before/after.
detector.numeric_guard: Finite active text-token logits, exact -inf padded/inactive logits, finite boxes, no NaN/+inf. Use the V81 official-padding guard contract.
detector.saved_audit_enhancement: Save complete raw FP32 active-token logits plus token IDs/attention mask and native/raw normalized boxes for each unique image/category, enabling exact saved score/text threshold replay. Padded -inf contract is certified in the actual runner, not reconstructed from omitted padding.

association.selection: Maximum continuous XYXY IoU of original initial q-box and each raw detector box; ties higher FP32 detector score then lower original query ordinal. No GT/context class mask chooses the detection.
association.SAM_prompt_box: Clip selected raw box to native image [0,W]x[0,H]. Positive finite area required.
association.missing_or_invalid: U with explicit reason, selected fields null, no fabricated zero mask. Do not lower thresholds to rescue rows.

SAM.runtime: Existing sealed SAM venv; frozen FP32 weights/eval, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 false, threads4, no compile, no postprocessing/hole/sprinkle filling.
SAM.prompt: Associated detector box only; no q clicks/GT point/counterexample-specific prompt.
SAM.mask_selection: multimask_output=false; single output index0. Predicted mask quality is recorded but not selected or gated.
SAM.API: Official public predict returns exact binary float32 0/1 at native [1,H,W]. Require finite exact0/1, then lossless bool conversion; no alternative threshold/tolerance.
SAM.decode_identity: Original file SHA/HW and decodedRGBbytes SHA must agree across detector and SAM. All823-like counts are output-dependent, not fixed admissions.

evaluation.frozen_GT_pack_reuse: V81 same1035 GT packet, nativeM0/M4 paths and strict535 membership. No relabel/changed subset.
evaluation.masks: Native whole-target M4 IoU, all rows no-mask0 and mask-available conditional means separately. Empty/failure denominators retained.
evaluation.q_prediction: Native floor(q+.5), original continuous and NN bounds; boolmask1 visible,0 not-visible-mask; invalid/no-mask U. Not a semantic E/S classifier.
benchmarks: separate exact q-pixel C/V conditional GT M0
same fixed V79 four diagnostic cases
evaluation.metrics: Rows GT C/V × columns pred C/V/U, precision on known C/V, end-to-end recall U as misses, hold rates, whole mask IoU. Compare saved V81/learned outputs only on matched IDs. No qO=semanticE/S.
evaluation.ownership_diagnostic: Reuse prospective V81 other-instance-IoU diagnostic bins to determine whether intended ownership improves, never choose output by GT-best IoU. Same-class ambiguity separately counted.

execution_boundaries.before_actual_execution: Input-only packet audit, generated threshold/association/API tests, exact code/asset/runtime/GT exclusion entrylock and independent review must pass. Preserve any failed attempt before repair.
